test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The solution is **unequivocal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5 is unequivocal.
 
• Similarly, mathematics, the bedrock of science, gives meaning to the concept of quantification and unequivocal value for us humans.
 
• **Unequivocal - **Leaving no doubt; unambiguous.
 
 
• *​For example : "An unequivocal answer,"*
 
 
 
• Therefore **option 3 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options :
 
 
• **Unapparent - **Not visible or in evidence.

 
 
• **​***For example : "The insidious, unapparent build-up of stress."*
 
 
 
• **Incomprehensible - **Not able to be understood; not intelligible.
 
 
• **​***For example : "A language which is incomprehensible to anyone outside the office."*
 
 
 
• **Undecipherable - **(of speech or writing) not able to be read or understood.
 
 
• **​***For example : "His almost undecipherable brogue."*
 
 
 
 

50:Tcd
